title: Workout Plan
message: Start slow. Use light weight. Stop if you feel pain.
howTo: Every exercise starts with 1 warm-up set: light weight, easy.
Then do 3 working sets of 12 reps.
Write your weight in the app. Next time, try a little more weight or 1–2 more reps.
Finish every day with 20 minutes of incline walking.

rest.name: Rest Day
rest.note: No gym today. Take an easy 20–30 min walk. Drink water. Sleep well. Muscles grow when you rest.

treadmill_warmup.name: Easy Treadmill Walk
treadmill_warmup.about: Walk slowly to warm up your body
treadmill_warmup.feel: Your body gets warm. Breathing a little faster. Not tired.
steps: Start the treadmill at a slow speed (3–4 km/h). No incline.
Walk tall. Swing your arms.
After 2 minutes, go a little faster.
Walk for 5 minutes total.
mistakes: Holding the rails the whole time

arm_circles.name: Arm Circles
steps: Lift both arms to the side, at shoulder height.
Make small circles. Slowly make them bigger.
Go forward first, then backward.
mistakes: Lifting shoulders up to the ears

hip_circles.name: Hip Circles
hip_circles.feel: Hips and lower back feel loose.
steps: Hands on your waist. Feet shoulder-width apart.
Slowly move your hips in a big circle.
Do the same number both ways.

bw_squat.name: Bodyweight Squat
bw_squat.about: Sit down and stand up, no weight
bw_squat.feel: Front of thighs and hips get warm.
steps: Feet shoulder-width apart. Toes a little out.
Push your hips back, like sitting on a chair.
Keep your chest up and back straight.
Push through your heels to stand up.
bw_squat.tip: If it feels hard, put a chair behind you. Sit lightly on it, then stand.

chest_press_machine.name: Chest Press Machine
chest_press_machine.about: Sit and push the handles forward
chest_press_machine.feel: Middle of your chest. Not your shoulders.
steps: Set the seat so the handles are at mid-chest.
Back flat on the pad. Feet on the floor.
Breathe out and push the handles forward. Don't lock your elbows.
Breathe in and slowly bring them back.
chest_press_machine.tip: Squeeze your chest at the front for 1 second.

pec_deck.name: Pec Deck
pec_deck.about: Bring the arms together in front of you
pec_deck.feel: Inside of your chest, near the middle.
steps: Set the seat so the handles are at chest height.
Sit with your back on the pad. Elbows a little bent.
Bring the handles together in front of your chest.
Squeeze 1 second. Slowly open your arms back.
mistakes: Opening the arms too far back

machine_shoulder_press.name: Machine Shoulder Press
machine_shoulder_press.about: Sit and push the handles above your head
machine_shoulder_press.feel: Top and front of your shoulders.
steps: Set the seat so the handles are at shoulder height.
Back flat on the pad. Feet on the floor.
Breathe out and push the handles up. Don't lock your elbows.
Slowly bring them back to shoulder height.
machine_shoulder_press.tip: If there is no machine, do the same with dumbbells, sitting on a bench with back support.

lateral_raise.name: Lateral Raise
lateral_raise.about: Lift dumbbells out to the side
lateral_raise.feel: Side of your shoulders. Not your neck.
steps: Stand with a light dumbbell in each hand.
Keep elbows a little bent.
Lift arms to the side, up to shoulder height. Not higher.
Slowly lower them.
lateral_raise.tip: This works best with very light weight.

lat_pulldown.name: Lat Pulldown
lat_pulldown.about: Pull the bar down to your chest
lat_pulldown.feel: Sides of your back, under your arms. Not only your arms.
steps: Fix the thigh pad tight. Sit down.
Hold the bar a little wider than your shoulders.
Chest up. Pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Slowly let it go up until arms are straight.
lat_pulldown.tip: Think: pull with your elbows, not your hands.

machine_row.name: Seated Machine Row
machine_row.about: Sit and pull the handles to your belly
machine_row.feel: Middle of your back, between the shoulder blades.
steps: Set the seat so the handles are at chest height. Chest on the pad.
Hold the handles with straight arms.
Pull the handles back. Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Slowly let your arms go forward.

reverse_pec_deck.name: Reverse Pec Deck
reverse_pec_deck.about: Open your arms back on the pec deck
reverse_pec_deck.feel: Back of your shoulders and upper back.
steps: Sit facing the machine. Chest on the pad.
Hold the handles in front, arms almost straight.
Open your arms out and back, like a wide hug in reverse.
Squeeze 1 second. Slowly bring them back.
reverse_pec_deck.tip: Very good for posture. Keep the weight light.

db_shrug.name: Dumbbell Shrug
db_shrug.about: Lift your shoulders up to your ears
db_shrug.feel: Top of your shoulders, near the neck.
steps: Stand straight with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Hold 1 second at the top.
Slowly lower them.

bar_pushdown.name: Triceps Pushdown (Bar)
steps: Stand facing the cable machine. Hold the bar, palms down.
Keep elbows close to your body.
Push down until your arms are straight. Only elbows move.
Slowly let it come back up.
mistakes: Leaning your body weight on it

rope_pushdown.name: Triceps Pushdown (Rope)
rope_pushdown.about: Push the cable rope down and apart
rope_pushdown.feel: Back of your upper arm, near the elbow.
steps: Attach the rope. Hold both ends, thumbs up.
Keep elbows close to your body.
Push down. At the bottom, pull the rope ends apart.
Slowly let it come back up.

overhead_rope_ext.name: Overhead Rope Extension
overhead_rope_ext.about: Push the rope up over your head
overhead_rope_ext.feel: Back of your upper arm, a stretch near the shoulder.
steps: Attach the rope low. Hold it and turn away from the machine.
Bring the rope behind your head, elbows pointing up.
Straighten your arms forward and up.
Slowly bend back. Feel the stretch.
overhead_rope_ext.tip: Stand with one foot in front for balance.

biceps_curl.name: Biceps Curl
biceps_curl.about: Lift the weight up to your shoulders
steps: Stand straight. Palms facing forward.
Keep elbows next to your body.
Lift the weight up toward your shoulders.
Slowly lower it all the way down.
biceps_curl.tip: You can use dumbbells or a bar. Both are fine.

hammer_curl.name: Hammer Curl
hammer_curl.feel: Front of upper arm and top of the forearm.
steps: Stand straight. Hold dumbbells with thumbs pointing up.
Keep elbows next to your body.
Lift the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Slowly lower them.

wrist_curl.name: Wrist Curl (Bar)
wrist_curl.about: Lift the bar using only your wrists
steps: Sit on a bench. Forearms on your thighs, palms up.
Hold a light bar. Wrists just past your knees.
Let the bar roll down to your fingers.
Curl your wrists up as high as you can. Slowly lower.
mistakes: Lifting the forearms off the thighs

leg_press.name: Leg Press
leg_press.about: Push the platform with your feet
leg_press.feel: Front of your thighs and your hips.
steps: Keep your back and hips flat on the seat.
Feet on the platform, shoulder-width apart.
Slowly bring knees toward your chest (about 90°).
Push through your heels. Don't lock your knees.
leg_press.tip: If your knees hurt, don't go down as far.

leg_extension.name: Seated Leg Extension
leg_extension.feel: Front of your thighs, above the knee.
steps: Sit on the machine. Pad sits on top of your ankles.
Hold the handles. Back on the seat.
Straighten your legs. Hold 1 second at the top.
Slowly lower them.
leg_extension.tip: If your knees hurt, keep it very light.

lying_leg_curl.name: Lying Leg Curl
lying_leg_curl.about: Lie down and bend your legs up
steps: Lie face down. Pad just above your heels.
Hold the handles. Hips stay on the bench.
Bend your legs and bring the pad toward your bottom.
Hold 1 second. Slowly lower.

adductor.name: Adductor Machine
steps: Sit with your back on the pad. Legs on the outside of the pads.
Start with legs open only as wide as is comfortable.
Squeeze your legs together.
Hold 1 second. Slowly open again.

leg_press_calf.name: Calf Raise on Leg Press
leg_press_calf.about: Push the platform with your toes
leg_press_calf.feel: Back of your lower legs (calves). Stretch at the bottom.
steps: Sit in the leg press. Put only your toes on the bottom of the platform.
Legs straight, knees soft (not locked).
Let your heels go back for a stretch.
Push with your toes as far as you can. Hold 1 second.
leg_press_calf.tip: Keep the safety locks on. Go slow.

incline_walk.name: Incline Treadmill Walk
incline_walk.feel: Breathing faster, legs working. You can still talk.
steps: Set speed to 4–5 km/h.
Set incline to 5–8%. Start lower if it is hard.
Walk tall. Swing your arms.
Walk for 20 minutes.
incline_walk.tip: Every week, add a little incline or speed.
